title: Marble Pestle, Easy Grinding, Suitable for Granite, Marble, Wood and Other Types of Mortar Replacement Pestle
description:
About this item
NATURAL MARBLE: This pestle is hand-polished from natural marble, using high-quality stone that is hard and long-lasting.
EASY GRINDING: The head of the pestle is frosted, the roughness of the head can increase the friction and easy to grind.
EASY TO USE: the marble pestle length of 5.5 inches is a little longer than most stone pestles, which makes it easier to grip and less effort when making sauces or grinding.
COMPATIBLE WITH MOST MORTAR: Heavy duty marble pestle, hard and durable can be compatible with most styles of mortar on the market, if your pestle accidentally breaks or is damaged, this replacement stone pestle is the right choice for you.

Within minutes I went to Amazon and found this one. I am over joyed!!! It matches very well and looks great with my old mortar. It is a wee bit longer but I love the balance and feel. I feel very grateful to have this replacement!!! Perfect!!!,❤️❤️
